annotations.title: Holidays on a date or in a year

description: Public holidays for the US (federal), GB (England and Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland), AU (states and territories) or CA (federal and provinces) for 2026 to 2028. Give a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a year, and optionally a region such as NSW, Scotland or ON. A date also matches a holiday's legal date (flagged match "legal_date") when the day off is observed on another day. Not every region has every year: a region-year with no data returns status no_data, not "no holiday". Sources: US OPM, GOV.UK (OGL v3.0), Australian and Canadian government pages named in each row.

region.description: Optional region, e.g. NSW, Scotland, ON.
